newsitem.title: USA: U.S. farm trade surplus $1.663 billion in July.
newsitem.headline: U.S. farm trade surplus $1.663 billion in July.

text.p: The U.S. trade surplus in agricultural commodities was $1.663 billion in July, down from a revised $1.741 billion in June, the Commerce Department said Wednesday.
In its monthly trade report, Commerce pegged farm exports at $4.359 billion in July, up from $4.276 billion in June. Imports were $2.696 billion, compared with $2.535 billion the previous month.
The cumulative surplus in farm trade was $15.330 billion in January to July, compared with $13.014 billion in the same period last year.

In July, the value of U.S. corn exports rose to $712 million from $640 million in June, and wheat exports rose to $621 million from $448 million. Soybean exports fell to $388 million from $430 million, the department said.
Exports of meat and meat preparations were $520 million, down from $530 million in June.
